title: The fewest lines a transpose can move

prereqs.why: The number asked for is the one a tiled transpose achieves and a naive one does not.
The whole count is in units of cache lines, so the line size is the unit of the answer.
Which of the two arrays is strided depends on the layout, and that is where the naive version loses.

hints: This is a question about how much data must move, not about the loop. How many bytes are in `a`, and how many must be written to `b`?
A 64-byte line holds eight doubles, and a line is the unit in which memory moves. How many lines does one matrix occupy?
Both matrices must be touched in full, and in the best case each of their lines is transferred exactly once.
